items.html: And behold, the root of the judgment of the Nukva is the left of ZA. Therefore he embraces the Achoraim of the female, where all the judgments were given by the sawing; and he embraces her with his left, and then they are mitigated, subdued, and sweetened. And the explanation of the matter of this embrace — its meaning is as above in the discourse of the Shofar: on the day of Rosh HaShanah, at the time of the casting of the deep sleep (Durmita) and slumber upon him, his mochin come out with their garments, which are the NNH of Ima, and leave within him, and he remains asleep. Then the two male mochin — Hochma and the side of Hesed — remain without their garments, in the aspect of Makifim upon the head of ZA; and the two female mochin — Bina and the side of Gevura — are clothed within the Hod of Bina alone, and enter within the Nukva in the aspect of mochin.
